name: llama3.2:1b
description: Meta's smallest current Llama; runs fine on CPU-only or low-RAM machines.

name: llama3.2:3b
description: Good general-purpose default -- what the bundled personas use.
recommended_reason: Best balance of speed and quality for a typical laptop; start here.

name: llama3.1:8b
description: Noticeably stronger reasoning than the 3.2 line; wants more RAM.

name: qwen2.5:0.5b
description: Extremely small and fast -- good for quick persona experiments, weaker output quality.
recommended_reason: Best pick for low-RAM machines or fast iteration while building personas.

name: qwen2.5:3b
description: Balanced small model, competitive with Llama 3.2 3B on most tasks.

name: qwen2.5:7b
description: Strong general-purpose model, particularly solid at coding tasks.
recommended_reason: Best quality if your machine has 16GB+ RAM to spare.

name: gemma2:2b
description: Google's small, efficient model -- a good llama3.2:1b alternative.

name: gemma2:9b
description: Larger Gemma 2 variant, stronger reasoning and longer context handling.

name: gemma3:4b
description: Newer Gemma generation; multimodal-capable base architecture.

name: phi3:mini
description: Microsoft's compact model, punches above its size on reasoning benchmarks.

name: phi4:14b
description: Newer, larger Phi generation with stronger reasoning; needs more RAM/VRAM.

name: codellama:7b
description: Meta's code-focused fine-tune -- better for a coding-assistant persona than general chat.

name: deepseek-r1:7b
description: Reasoning-focused distilled model; shows its chain-of-thought before answering.

name: moondream
description: Tiny vision-language model -- can describe images, not just text chat.
